verdict.rationale: Column's bank-accounts docs list 'sweep' as a supported account type, which is a thin first-party sign that sweep options exist. Nothing in the pack covers interest-bearing accounts, how rates are set, or who keeps the spread. missing for 10: documented interest-bearing accounts, sweep mechanics and destinations, rate/yield mechanics, spread/revenue-share disclosure, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, idle balances can earn — interest-bearing accounts or documented sweep options, with the rate mechanics and who keeps the spread spelled out

citations.quote: We support FBO, sweep, clearing and custom account types.
